 Contents

 
 
5,191 curated resources (4,025 cases) · 442 papers · 3,309 indexed repositories · latest source review 2026-11-09.

 

 
 
- Find by task
- Use the data
- Resources (5,188)
 - Website (128) — Tools and cases for inspecting, deobfuscating and rebuilding websites
 - Game (2,976) — Decompilations, recompilations, ports, engine reimplementations, analysis tools and cases
 - App (370) — Analysis tools and cases for Android, .NET, JVM and Electron apps
 - Native Binary (502) — Disassemblers, decompilers, debuggers, binary libraries, diffing tools and native cases
 - Firmware and Hardware (260) — Firmware extraction and analysis tools, plus hardware and device-image cases
 - Protocol (720) — Tools and cases for wire formats, device protocols and packet captures
 - Agents and MCP (91) — Official REA material, MCP servers, integrations and agent workflows, labelled by REA relationship
 - Related Collections (33) — Other curated lists on reverse engineering and related security topics
 - References and Learning (108) — Documentation, investigation guides, labs and learning resources
- Papers (442) — Research bibliography, kept in generated paper lists
 - Most recent papers (10)

 Use the data

Use these public files and pages to read the catalog, follow changes, or work with its structured data.

- llms.txt - Machine-readable site map for language models.
- llms-full.txt - Curated entries in one Markdown text.
- API index - Static JSON and CSV exports of resources, papers and categories, plus unreviewed candidates.
- catalog.json - Curated catalog in one JSON file.
- JSON Feed - New and changed entries in JSON Feed format.
- Hugging Face dataset - Parquet and JSONL exports for resources, papers, cases and discovery records.
- Catalog format - Fields, vocabulary and review rules for every record.

 
 Resources

Names link to original sources. Each line gives the opening sentence of the description, then the type and relationship; “Full entry” opens the complete description, prerequisites, limitations and review sources.

Each resource appears once under its main purpose. Cases reuse these entries; papers are listed separately.

REA labels refer to the separate upstream CLI and MCP project, described under About.

 
 
 Tags: Official REA: published by the REA project · Community REA: third-party REA work · REA maintainer: an REA maintainer's list · Independent MCP, Independent agent, Independent reconstruction: no established REA connection · Mixed workflow: REA plus other tools, per the author · Android, .NET, JVM, WebAssembly: platform · Library: code library · type only: foundation tool or learning resource.
